items: Specifically designed for the latest model of Flawless Facial Hair Remover, please ensure compatibility before purchase. (Note: If you are unsure of your product model, please refer to our second product image).
The new replacement heads feature improved floating blades and raised plastic parts that conform to your facial contours for a more effective shave.
After each use, twist and remove the head, and tap it on the counter to remove any excess hair. If needed, use our cleaning brush to clear away any remaining hair.
Each order includes 6 third-generation hypoallergenic facial hair remover replacement heads and 1 cleaning brush.
For optimal performance, it is recommended to replace the Flawless replacement heads every 3-6 months.
